acceptance: contain selects a fully enclosed element: given rectangle A at (100,100) 100x100; lasso (50,50)-(250,250); boxSelectionMode "contain", expect ["A"]

contain ignores an element the lasso only crosses: given rectangle A at (100,100) 100x100; band lasso (130,50)-(170,250) crossing its top and bottom edges, expect "contain" gives []; "overlap" gives ["A"]
contain ignores a partly enclosed element: given rectangle A at (100,100) 100x100; lasso (50,50)-(150,150) enclosing only its top-left corner, expect "contain" gives []; "overlap" gives ["A"]
omitting boxSelectionMode keeps overlap results: given the partial lasso of the previous case and no boxSelectionMode option, expect ["A"]

contain selects a container only when its bound text is enclosed too: given the bound-text fixture; lasso (80,80)-(220,220) wraps the container but cuts the label, then lasso (40,40)-(260,260) wraps both, expect first gives []; second gives ["container"] (no label id)
contain drops a partly enclosed group and keeps other wrapped elements: given A (100,100) and B (300,100) 50x50 in group g1, ungrouped C (100,250) 50x50; lasso (50,50)-(200,350), expect ["C"]
contain selects a group when every member is enclosed: given the same A, B, C; lasso (50,50)-(400,350), expect ["A", "B", "C"]
contain inside an edited group does not require the whole group: given the same A, B, C; lasso (50,50)-(200,350); editingGroupId "g1", expect ["A", "C"]
wrap stroke selects only the fully enclosed element: given A (100,100) 50x50, B (300,100) 100x100; boxSelectionMode "contain"; lassoStroke (50,50)-(350,250), expect selection is [A]
overlap stroke selects crossed and partly enclosed elements: given the same A, B; boxSelectionMode "overlap"; the same stroke, expect selection is [A, B]

wrap stroke over part of a group selects nothing: given A (100,100) and B (300,100) 50x50 in group g1; "contain"; stroke (50,50)-(200,200), then stroke (50,50)-(400,200), expect first leaves the selection empty; second selects [A, B] and h.state.selectedGroupIds.g1 is true
overlap stroke over one group member selects the whole group: given the same grouped A, B; "overlap"; stroke (50,50)-(200,200), expect selection is [A, B]

wrap stroke selects a container only with its bound text enclosed: given the bound-text fixture; "contain"; stroke (80,80)-(220,220), then stroke (40,40)-(260,260), expect first leaves the selection empty; second selects [container]
overlap stroke over bound text selects its container: given the bound-text fixture; "overlap"; stroke (40,120)-(90,180) touching only the label's left overflow, expect selection is [container]

frame children are removed from the selection in both modes: given frame `frame` (100,100) 200x200 and rectangle `child` (150,150) 50x50 with frameId "frame"; for each of "contain" and "overlap", stroke (50,50)-(350,350), expect selection is [frame] in both modes

switching the preference between strokes changes the second stroke: given A (100,100) 50x50, B (300,100) 100x100; "contain" and stroke (50,50)-(350,250); then API.setAppState overlap and the same stroke, expect first selects [A]; second selects [A, B]
